categories.name: Aarakocra
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a bird-person who fights from the sky and never needs the ground.

categories.name: Aasimar
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be someone with an angel's touch who can grow wings and heal with light.

categories.name: Autognome
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a small clockwork person someone else built, who keeps tinkering with their own parts.

categories.name: Bugbear
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a big hairy brute who is scarily good at surprising people.

categories.name: Changeling
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be someone who can change their face and voice and become anyone.

categories.name: Dhampir
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a half-vampire who walks somewhere between the living and the dead.

categories.name: Dragonborn
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a proud dragon-person who breathes elemental power and stands tall.

categories.name: Dwarf
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a tough, stubborn person who likes working stone, good ale, and never letting a grudge go.

categories.name: Eladrin (Elf)
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a fey elf who teleports short distances and changes with their moods.

categories.name: Elf
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a graceful, long-lived person who is good with bows, swords and magic.

categories.name: Firbolg
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a gentle forest giant who can talk to animals and plants.

categories.name: Githyanki
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a stern astral warrior with a silver sword and psionic power.

categories.name: Githzerai
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a disciplined, monk-like person who trusts their own mind above everything.

categories.name: Gnome
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a small, curious tinkerer with a natural knack for magic.

categories.name: Goblin
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a scrappy little creature who runs away, hides, and comes back when it suits them.

categories.name: Goliath
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a mountain of a person who competes with everything, including the weather.

categories.name: Half-Elf
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be someone caught between two worlds who is good at talking to both.

categories.name: Half-Orc
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a tough person who hits very hard and refuses to stay down.

categories.name: Halfling
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a small, lucky, cheerful person who is good at sneaking and staying out of trouble.

categories.name: Hexblood
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be someone touched by hags, with a witchy streak and curses that linger.

categories.name: Hobgoblin
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a disciplined, military-minded goblin-kin who fights best as a unit.

categories.name: Human
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be the adaptable everyman who can grow into almost anything.

categories.name: Kenku
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a bird-person who cannot speak their own words and can only copy sounds they have heard.

categories.name: Kobold
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a tiny dragon-kin who is weak alone but dangerous in a pack.

categories.name: Lizardfolk
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a cold, practical reptile-person who survives on instinct rather than feelings.

categories.name: Orc
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a relentless brute who charges first and refuses to fall.

categories.name: Plasmoid
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a living blob of ooze who can squeeze through a keyhole.

categories.name: Reborn
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be someone who died and came back, not quite the same as before.

categories.name: Shifter
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be part-beast who grows more animal exactly when it matters.

categories.name: Tabaxi
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a cat-person who is impossibly fast, curious and hard to keep still.

categories.name: Thri-kreen
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a four-armed insect-person who never needs to sleep.

categories.name: Tiefling
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be someone with demon blood, horns and fire in their veins who people distrust on sight.

categories.name: Triton
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a proud guardian of the deep sea who is at home in the water.

categories.name: Yuan-ti Pureblood
categories.flavor: Play this if you want to be a snake-person who shrugs off poison and is hard to charm.
